title: Build an AI Chat App
description: Build a production-ready AI chat application featuring real-time streaming, conversation memory, and RAG integration using Claude's API.
learning_objectives: Implement a streaming response interface to reduce perceived latency
Develop a conversation memory system to maintain multi-turn context
Integrate a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for grounding responses in external data
Configure Claude's API for high-performance chat interactions
prerequisites: Basic proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python
Understanding of REST APIs and environment variable management
Knowledge of basic prompt engineering principles

sections.heading: System Architecture: The Chat Pipeline
sections.content_brief: Explain the high-level data flow from user input to final output. Detail how the system orchestrates retrieval, memory injection, and streaming delivery.

sections.heading: Implementing Real-time Streaming
sections.content_brief: Demonstrate how to use Claude's streaming API to send chunks of text to the client as they are generated. Cover the implementation of Server-Sent Events (SSE) or a similar streaming transport.
sections.code_context: Implementing an API route that streams Claude's response chunks to a frontend client.

sections.heading: Managing Conversation Memory
sections.content_brief: Explain the difference between short-term and long-term memory. Implement a sliding window buffer or summary-based approach to keep the conversation context within token limits.
sections.code_context: A utility class for managing chat history and pruning old messages based on token count.

sections.heading: Adding RAG Capabilities
sections.content_brief: Show how to retrieve relevant document snippets from a knowledge base and inject them into the system prompt. Explain the 'Context' block pattern used to ground the AI.
sections.code_context: A function that queries a vector store and formats retrieved documents for the LLM prompt.

sections.heading: End-to-End Example: Full Chat Cycle
sections.content_brief: A concrete step-by-step walkthrough showing the full sequence from user input through each intermediate step (retrieval, memory merging, API call) to final output.
sections.code_context: The complete integrated logic combining RAG, Memory, and Streaming in a single request handler.

admonitions.content: Be careful with unbounded memory growth; always implement a pruning strategy or summary mechanism to avoid hitting the model's maximum context window.
To improve RAG quality, try adding 'citations' to your system prompt, instructing Claude to reference specific documents when answering.
